description: Update merchant-fe SettlementConfig.tsx frontend layout to match super-merchant's SettlementConfigTab component. Key changes: (1) InfoRow component uses flex-col (label on top, value below) not side-by-side; (2) Settlement Schedule card shows only Settlement Type and Settlement Days in 2-column grid; (3) MSC Breakdown card replaces Settlement Account Details in the second column with 2-column grid layout; (4) Settlement Accounts card spans full width (lg:col-span-2) and displays accounts in a scrollable list matching the existing pattern. The merchant version is read-only (no Edit buttons) but keeps the existing Add Account functionality.
steps: 1. Update the InfoRow component in /Users/mathew/merchant-fe/app/(user)/settlements/(files)/SettlementConfig.tsx to use flex-col layout: change from 'flex justify-between py-3 border-b border-border last:border-b-0' to 'flex flex-col gap-1 py-3'. Change label to text-xs (from text-sm) and value remains text-sm font-medium.

2. Restructure the Settlement Schedule Card to use a 2-column grid inside CardContent: wrap InfoRows in a div with 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-1'. Show only Settlement Type and Settlement Days (remove Settlement Time InfoRow).

3. Move MSC Breakdown card to be the second card in the grid (replacing Settlement Account Details position). Change it from lg:col-span-2 to no col-span. Use the new InfoRow style in a 2-column grid: MSC (POS), Instant Transfer Fee in first row; Monthly Terminal Fee alone in second row.

4. Move Settlement Account Details card (rename to 'Settlement Accounts' to match super-merchant) to span full width with lg:col-span-2. Keep the existing account list rendering and Add Account button functionality. The card should come after the Schedule and MSC cards.
5. Update the grid layout: the main grid should be 'grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 items-start'. Settlement Schedule is first, MSC Breakdown second, Settlement Accounts spans full width below.
6. Remove the inline 3-column stat boxes in MSC Breakdown (the p-4 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg divs) and use InfoRow components instead for consistency with super-merchant.

7. Ensure all styling follows design system: card padding p-6 via CardContent, section gaps gap-6, card titles text-base font-medium, labels text-xs, values text-sm font-medium, use semantic colors (text-muted-foreground for labels, text-foreground for values).
acceptance_criteria: InfoRow uses flex-col layout with label (text-xs) on top, value (text-sm font-medium) below
Settlement Schedule card shows only Settlement Type and Settlement Days in 2-col grid
MSC Breakdown card is in second column (not full width), uses InfoRow style in 2-col grid
Settlement Accounts card spans full width (lg:col-span-2) with existing account list and Add Account button
Layout matches super-merchant's SettlementConfigTab visual structure
verification: Run npm run build in /Users/mathew/merchant-fe to verify TypeScript compilation
findings: Implementation complete. Updated InfoRow to use flex-col layout (label text-xs on top, value text-sm font-medium below). MSC Breakdown moved to second column position with InfoRow components in 2-column grid instead of inline stat boxes.
